checks.name: Every entity name is in the pinned prototypes and in the allowed set
Unique entity IDs
Blueprint version is 2.1.25
No modules, no quality, no tiles, no custom inserter reach
Rotated collision boxes do not overlap
Machines: 7 foundries, 19 assembling machines 3, 1 chemical plant, 1 electric furnace
Every fixed recipe is pinned and can be crafted in its machine
Every switching and shadow machine takes its recipe from the circuit network and has no fixed recipe
Every rule selects a pinned recipe its machine can craft
The ring is one directed unbranched closed loop of red belt
No belt outside the ring points into the ring
Exactly one ring belt reads the whole ring (hold); every other ring belt only carries the wire
Every arm picks up and drops where its role says
Every arm has its hand size pinned (fast 1, bulk 2, long-handed 1)
Every ring-feeding arm is gated on its item below the ring limit
Every level-gated arm is enabled only at or below its level
Chest OUT-1: its arm takes from the ring and drops into its chest
Chest OUT-2: its arm takes from the ring and drops into its chest
Chest OUT-3: its arm takes from the ring and drops into its chest
Chest OUT-4: its arm takes from the ring and drops into its chest
Chest OUT-5: its arm takes from the ring and drops into its chest
Every pipe, underground pipe and tank belongs to exactly one declared fluid
No pipe of one fluid connects to a pipe of another
No machine is mirrored (its fluid ports lie as the pinned prototype says)
No machine has two ports of one kind on pipes of different fluids (a second fluid comes through a pump on the port)
Every machine fluid port touches the fluid it is meant to (and nothing else touches a port)
Each pump stands directly between its source and the foundry port it feeds (nothing flows back through it)
Every underground pipe has exactly one partner within ten tiles
The lava pipes form one network
The molten-copper pipes form one network
The molten-iron pipes form one network
The water pipes form one network
The lubricant pipes form one network
The sulfuric-acid pipes form one network
No connector belongs to two circuit nets
Every circuit wire joins two members of the same net and is within reach
Every circuit net is connected
Rule deciders read loose stock on red and the control net on green
Every powered entity stands in a substation supply area
Power is four substations in one copper chain, nothing else
Every product has a rule or flag at its group level
Every level weight sits in its level band
Each switching machine has a parking recipe: an idle rule (casting foundries) or a park decider (U1, U2)
The recipe wire of U1 and U2 is never without a recipe: "parked" is also raised on the tick a craft ends with the pick to park
The caps combinator holds every cap, the kit chest's fast inserters as signal K
Every stock has exactly one chest; only fast inserters are in two (kit chest and inserter chest)
The kit chest reaches the control net only through its pass (fast inserters masked) and its own count Q
Every chest list names exactly its declared products
Output chests are passive providers; the only other chest is the brick stock
Every entrance, the stone exit, the power connection, the caps combinator and every chest has a display panel
The ring limits of each lane, all reached at once, fit that lane
The technology closure includes the foundry, the space platform and the selector combinator
